comment: Apps and scenarios of the benchmark suite. `dir` is a directory of benchmark/apps; `flags` are extra compiler flags; an app is built to benchmark/apps/<dir>/bin/<name>. `default: false` apps run only when named in --apps.

apps.name: baseline
apps.stack: HTTP::Server, hand-written dispatch, ECR, crystal-sqlite3, HTTP::WebSocketHandler

apps.name: azu
apps.stack: Azu::App, default handlers without the request logger, compiled Jinja (Azu::Templates.compile), CQL (SQLite), Azu::Channel

apps.name: kemal
apps.stack: Kemal 1.9.0 default handlers, logging off, ECR, crystal-sqlite3, Kemal ws

apps.name: athena
apps.stack: Athena 0.23.0 default listeners, ECR, crystal-sqlite3; no WebSocket support

apps.name: lucky
apps.stack: Lucky 1.5.0 ErrorHandler/RouteHandler, HTMLPage, crystal-sqlite3; no WebSocket support

apps.name: azu-min
apps.stack: azu with Handler::Rescuer only, plus the App::Scope wrapper every Azu::App adds (in-flight counter, current app/config): router + endpoint + Scope + Rescuer, without RequestId, SecurityHeaders and Static

apps.name: azu-min-rawdb
apps.stack: azu-min with crystal-sqlite3 instead of CQL: the closest Azu gets to the baseline, for the DB scenarios

apps.name: azu-rawdb
apps.stack: azu with crystal-sqlite3 instead of CQL: isolates the ORM cost in the DB scenarios
